jobs.title: Video Creative Lead
jobs.description: Careers at Simply | Join the Simply team Skip to main content Skip to footer Video Creative Lead Creative | Tel Aviv-Yafo APPLY NOW Simply's mission is to make the pursuit of creative hobbies simple and fun for all. Our top-grossing apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, and Simply Draw put us on the fast track to building the world's largest consumer subscription service for creative learning. With over a million monthly downloads and hundreds of thousands of daily learners, we're building the AI creative companion for every home. We’re expanding our world-class team and looking for a full-stack Performance Video Creative Lead to join new, exciting initiatives. In this role, you will develop large-scale video ads that will be key in expanding Simply’s growth. You will have full ownership of the creative process end-to-end from ideation, through production down to the final product and publication. We are looking for an independent, hands-on, proactive, creative thinker passionate about well-executed exceptional ideas that show our products, tell our stories, and drive sales. This is a lead role in a critical operation of our growing, do-good startup, that’s changing people’s lives. Who are we looking for? 5+ years of hands-on experience in video creation of successful ads/performance marketing across all main platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, etc.) A resourceful professional who is able to lead and execute video creation processes end-to-end, from ideation to production, including hands-on directing and editing (Post-production experience is a bonus). A deep understanding of social media content and trends. Experience working with acquisition teams (campaign managers) to apply data-driven learnings to improve creative performance. You are a team player, passionate and curious about what we do. You’re willing to take on new challenges, have great interpersonal skills, and are a proactive problem-solver with executional excellence and precision. Experience in Short-Form videos (Ads, UGC ads, and Organic content) for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube Shorts is an advantage. Experience in Filming or Motion Graphics and Post-Production is an advantage. When applying, please attach your CV and a link to your most relevant work. Thank you! Apply here

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description: Careers at Simply | Join the Simply team Skip to main content Skip to footer Legal Counsel Finance & Legal | HQ APPLY NOW Legal Counsel Simply's mission is to make the pursuit of creative hobbies simple and fun for all. Our top-grossing apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, and Simply Draw put us on the fast track to building the world's largest consumer subscription service for creative learning. With over a million monthly downloads and hundreds of thousands of daily learners, we're building the AI creative companion for every home. We are looking for a Legal Counsel to build and lead the legal function from the ground up, partnering closely with leadership across all areas of the business in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. Why Join Simply? Develop the Legal Function : This is an opportunity to develop, lead, and scale the entire legal infrastructure, impacting how our global company operates. Cross Department Impact : Act as the legal partner across the business, with direct involvement in high-level corporate activities including supporting M&A, fundraising, and core business transactions. Mission-Driven Growth : Join a purpose-driven, fast-growing consumer subscription company that is actively enriching the lives of millions worldwide by making creative hobbies simple and fun. Autonomy & Ownership : We operate with high autonomy, speed, and initiative, and value people who proactively create structure where none exists. You will take ownership of key legal domains and proactively drive critical initiatives. Key Responsibilities Commercial & Product Counsel al partner, providing pragmatic, business-oriented counsel to stakeholders across the company on commercial, product, and regulatory matters. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Business teams on launches, partnerships, and new initiatives. Provide practical, business-oriented guidance that balances risk with speed and execution. Risk, Compliance, & Governance Lead and implement internal processes to manage and mitigate potential risks related to privacy, data security, and insurance policies. Strategic Transactions & Intellectual Property Support strategic corporate activities, including fundraising, M&A, and ongoing IP initiatives (trademark, patent, etc.). Legal Operations & Infrastructure Build, improve, and scale legal processes, templates, and playbooks to support the company’s rapid growth. Identify and initiate opportunities for internal legal education, training, and knowledge sharing. Take ownership of key legal domains, proactively driving initiatives and managing all engagement with outside counsel. Required Experience & Skills 5+ years of post-bar commercial law experience from a leading law firm and/or in-house technology company. Experience drafting and negotiating licensing and commercial agreements. Hands-on experience advising on US and international privacy, data security, and compliance matters. Proven track record in building and scaling legal infrastructure, processes, templates, and playbooks in a high-growth environment. Experience managing corporate governance matters, including preparing board and shareholder resolutions and maintaining corporate records. Highly effective collaborator and team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills (English and Hebrew - a must), known for being service-oriented and able to engage cross-functional team members. Experience working with startups or high-growth technology companies is a strong advantage. Experience working with music publishers, licensing agreements, or media/content-related commercial partnerships is a strong advantage. Apply here

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: Careers at Simply | Join the Simply team Skip to main content Skip to footer Senior AI Research Engineer R&D | Tel Aviv-Yafo APPLY NOW Simply’s mission is to make the pursuit of creative hobbies simple and fun . Our top-grossing apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, and Simply Draw put us on the fast track to building the world’s largest global consumer subscription service that’s revolutionizing how we spend our time at home. With over a million monthly downloads and hundreds of thousands of daily learners around the world, we’re redefining creative learning at scale. What Senior AI Research Engineers do at Simply Senior AI Research Engineers at Simply develop algorithmic solutions that power new innovative features and continuously improve existing ones, with a strong emphasis on training AI / ML models as a core part of the role. The work spans a wide range of domains - from training generative AI and LLM-based models to create musical content at scale for Simply Piano, through building deep learning computer vision models that enhance user drawings in Simply Draw, to developing real-time audio ML models for music transcription that elevate feedback in Simply Guitar. You will take full end-to-end ownership of cutting-edge algorithms and AI models - leading the process from ideation and research, through development, to production-grade implementation and engineering within Simply’s products. This includes not only designing and building AI models, but also ensuring robust, efficient, and scalable integration into the app - directly shaping the experience of millions of users. Who you are and what you’ve done Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field 3+ years of experience in designing and implementing AI/ML algorithms, with a strong focus on signal processing Proven experience working across the full ML lifecycle - from data acquisition and model training to production implementation and ongoing product iteration. Moves fast, with strong engineering instincts, able to choose the right level of complexity to drive real-world impact A get things done attitude with a strong sense of ownership A team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to convey complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills A fast learner, willing to try things out of your comfort zone Experience in speech, audio, or music-related domains - Advantage Apply here
